import os,re,json
from collections import Counter, deque
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def f(g,mode):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    o=[r[:] for r in g]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j]==bg:
                hfl = 0<j<W-1 and g[i][j-1]!=bg and g[i][j+1]!=bg
                vfl = 0<i<H-1 and g[i-1][j]!=bg and g[i+1][j]!=bg
                ok=False
                if mode=='horiz' and hfl: ok=True
                elif mode=='vert' and vfl: ok=True
                elif mode=='both' and (hfl or vfl): ok=True
                elif mode=='and' and hfl and vfl: ok=True
                if ok: o[i][j]=4
    return o
names=['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']
for n in names:
    gi,go=G[n+' input'],G[n+' output']
    print(n,'horiz',f(gi,'horiz')==go,'vert',f(gi,'vert')==go,'both',f(gi,'both')==go,'and',f(gi,'and')==go)

def f(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r_ in g for x in r_).most_common(1)[0][0]
    o=[r[:] for r in g]
    # enclosed: not 4-connected to border
    seen=set()
    q=deque([(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in (0,W-1)]+[(i,j) for j in range(W) for i in (0,H-1)])
    while q:
        r_,c_=q.popleft()
        if (r_,c_) in seen: continue
        if g[r_][c_]!=bg: continue
        seen.add((r_,c_))
        for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            nr,nc=r_+dr,c_+dc
            if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and g[nr][nc]==bg and (nr,nc) not in seen:
                q.append((nr,nc))
    def ufg(r_,c_): return r_>0 and g[r_-1][c_]!=bg
    def df_(r_,c_): return r_<H-1 and g[r_+1][c_]!=bg
    def lfg(r_,c_): return c_>0 and g[r_][c_-1]!=bg
    def rfg(r_,c_): return c_<W-1 and g[r_][c_+1]!=bg
    for r_ in range(H):
        for c_ in range(W):
            if g[r_][c_]!=bg or (r_,c_) in seen: continue
            u_,d_,l_,r_=ufg(r_,c_),df_(r_,c_),lfg(r_,c_),rfg(r_,c_)
            if u_ and d_: o[r_][c_]=4
            elif l_ and r_: o[r_][c_]=4
    return o
for n in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5','Demo pair 6','Demo pair 7']:
    gi=G[n+' input']; go=G[n+' output']
    p=f(gi)
    d=[(r,c) for r in range(len(go)) for c in range(len(go[0])) if p[r][c]!=go[r][c]]
    print(n,'diff',len(d),d[:8])

def f_line(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r_ in g for x in r_).most_common(1)[0][0]
    o=[r[:] for r in g]
    seen=set()
    q=deque([(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in (0,W-1)]+[(i,j) for j in range(W) for i in (0,H-1)])
    while q:
        r_,c_=q.popleft()
        if (r_,c_) in seen or g[r_][c_]!=bg: continue
        seen.add((r_,c_))
        for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            nr,nc=r_+dr,c_+dc
            if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and g[nr][nc]==bg and (nr,nc) not in seen:
                q.append((nr,nc))
    for r_ in range(H):
        for c_ in range(W):
            if g[r_][c_]!=bg or (r_,c_) in seen: continue
            col_fg_above=any(g[r_2][c_]!=bg for r_2 in range(r_))
            col_fg_below=any(g[r_2][c_]!=bg for r_2 in range(r_+1,H))
            row_fg_left=any(g[r_][c_2]!=bg for c_2 in range(c_))
            row_fg_right=any(g[r_][c_2]!=bg for c_2 in range(c_+1,W))
            if (col_fg_above and col_fg_below) or (row_fg_left and row_fg_right):
                o[r_][c_]=4
    return o
for n in ['Demo pair %d'%k for k in range(1,8)]:
    gi=G[n+' input']; go=G[n+' output']
    p=f_line(gi)
    d=[(r,c) for r in range(len(go)) for c in range(len(go[0])) if p[r][c]!=go[r][c]]
    print(n,'diff',len(d),d[:8])

def rect_rule(gi):
    H=len(gi);W=len(gi[0])
    bgv=Counter(x for r_ in gi for x in r_).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[row[:] for row in gi]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if gi[i][j]!=bgv: continue
            u=i
            while u>-1 and gi[u][j]==bgv: u-=1
            d=i
            while d<H and gi[d][j]==bgv: d+=1
            l=j
            while l>=0 and gi[i][l]==bgv: l-=1
            r=j
            while r<W and gi[i][r]==bgv: r+=1
            if u>=0 and d<H and l>=0 and r<W: out[i][j]=4
    return out
